# Vimicx

> Vimicx creates live 3D models displayed in AR glasses, transforming complex, hard-to-interpret data into spatial understanding you can see, touch, and act on.

## Core Capabilities
- **Live 3D Vision**: Performs real-time mesh generation directly from live sonar, LiDAR, and other raw sensor feeds with zero pre-processing or waiting.
- **AR Display Adaptable**: Designed to operate completely hands-free with lightweight, comfortable AR glasses for active users (e.g., anglers, field engineers), and fully compatible with any AR-enabled mobile device.
- **AI World Model**: Utilizes a fine-tuned AI world model to solve visual occlusion and enable autonomous target tracking, converting complex 3D sensor data into an intuitive overlay.

## Process / How It Works
1. **Ingest & Fuse**: Connects to any data source (sonar, LiDAR, IoT sensors, telemetry feeds) and fuses them into a unified spatial model in milliseconds.
2. **Model & Render**: Construct a live 3D mesh (including topology, highlighted targets, and customized data layers) optimized for real-time, low-latency AR displays.
3. **Display & Act**: Streams the live 3D model directly to AR glasses, overlaying targets, underwater structures, and anomalies directly onto the physical environment.

## Key Performance Metrics
- **Rendering Latency**: < 5ms
- **Refresh Rate**: 120 FPS for smooth AR representation
- **Coverage**: 360° spatial coverage
- **Data Layers**: Unlimited custom data overlays

## Industry Applications
- **Marine & Fishing**: Replaces complex traditional sonar displays with a live 3D underwater view. Allows anglers to see bottom topology, physical structure, and fish targets in real-time through AR glasses ("See Through Water").
- **Industrial Inspection**: Overlays thermal, structural, and real-time sensor data onto physical infrastructure to instantly identify defects, stress points, and operational anomalies.
- **Defense & Security**: Fuses multi-sensor feeds (radar, sonar, surveillance) into a unified, high-fidelity 3D operational picture for superior situational awareness in any environment.
